name: F2b_tangent_sign_above
sw_rationale: Family 2 (Tangent sign). A circle r=10 whose center.x is fixed at 0 and center.y is FREE, initial center at (0,14). A horizontal line fixed at y=0. Tangent constraint means |center.y| = 10. Two branches: center.y=+10 (circle above line, touching from above) or center.y=-10 (circle below line). Since initial center.y=14>0, SolidWorks stays on the ABOVE branch: center.y=+10. Expected center = (0,10). Confidence HIGH.

expect._coord_notes: center must be (0, +10), NOT (0,-10). Circle is above the line (line at y=0). The tangent constraint picks the above branch because initial center.y=14 > 0.
